entry.title: New: Resolution 495 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 495-26 & FC-138 - 04/22/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PLANNING DEPARTMENT TO AWARD FUNDS FOR THE KĪLAUEA RECOVERY GRANT PROGRAM

Provides $501,100 in grant funds to various nonprofit organizations to provide relief, recovery, mitigation, and long-term resilience for disaster damages, losses, and suffering caused by the 2018 Kīlauea eruption.
